name: Merboltice (Czechia)
description: Five horizontal stripes of white, red, yellow, red and white in the ratio 1:1:1:1:1.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 15 December 1998 (decision No. 10) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
